customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
cell = self.view.params.cellLocationId
	opts = BlueRidge.Parts.Item.getEligibleForLocationDropdown(cell) if cell else []
	itemId = self.view.params.itemId
	if not itemId and len(opts) == 1:
		itemId = opts[0]["value"]
	self.view.custom.partOptions = opts
	self.view.custom.itemId = itemId
	self.loadPart()

customMethods.name: loadPart
customMethods.script:
itemId = self.view.custom.itemId
	self.view.custom.activeField = ""
	self.view.custom.editDraft = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.getDraftForItem(itemId)
	self.view.custom.history = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.getHistoryForItem(itemId)
	pn = ""
	if itemId:
		item = BlueRidge.Parts.Item.getOneOrEmpty(itemId) or {}
		pn = "%s" % (item["PartNumber"] or "")
	self.view.custom.partLabel = pn

customMethods.name: addMethod
customMethods.script:
draft = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.editDraft)) or {}
	block = draft.get(method) or {}
	block["Active"] = True
	block["ClosureMethod"] = method
	block["ItemId"] = self.view.custom.itemId
	draft[method] = block
	self.view.custom.editDraft = draft
	self.view.custom.activeField = method + ".PartsPerTray"

customMethods.name: clearMethod
applyHistory
customMethods.script:
hist = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.history)) or {}
	row = (hist.get("rows") or {}).get("%s" % key)
	if not row:
		return
	draft = system.util.jsonDecode(BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.editDraft)) or {}
	cur = draft.get(method) or {}
	block = dict(row)
	block["Id"] = cur.get("Id")
	block["ItemId"] = self.view.custom.itemId
	block["ClosureMethod"] = method
	block["Active"] = True
	draft[method] = block
	self.view.custom.editDraft = draft
	self.view.custom.activeField = ""
	BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Previous pack-out loaded", "Check the values, then press Save to apply.", "info")

customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
if not self.view.custom.itemId:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No part selected", "Pick the part this pack-out is for.", "warning")
		return
	nowMs = system.date.toMillis(system.date.now())
	if nowMs < (self.view.custom.busyUntil or 0):
		return
	self.view.custom.busyUntil = nowMs + 2000
	res = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.saveDraft(self.view.custom.itemId, self.view.custom.editDraft, appUserId=BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session))
	if res and res.get("Status"):
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out saved", self.view.custom.partLabel, "success")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("packOutChanged", payload={"itemId": self.view.custom.itemId}, scope="page")
		system.perspective.closePopup("mpp-packout-edit")
	else:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pack-out not saved", (res or {}).get("Message") or "Unknown error", "error")
		self.view.custom.busyUntil = 0
		self.loadPart()
